title: Audit selective P112 co-delivery composition and scoped repair costs
body:
The four low-correction tetrads in PR #3604 compose exactly at the abstract centre readout, but their port update differs from the original decoder target. This package checks that selective composition and identifies where the nominal saving is repaid; it supplies no new native supplier or κ increase.

## Finding

- Original-completion blocks 0, 3, 10 and 13 give the stated **104 versus 112 sensitivity bill**, with shared centre corrections added exactly. The changed live-port target has rational defect rank **16**.
- The specified post-readout port-repair factorization adds 20 rank units, yielding **124 versus 112** before source acquisition, frames, hosting and cleanup. This is one losing repair, not a minimum or universal obstruction.
- A correctly oriented four-block `U; scatter(US); U^-1` forward control preserves all 704 normalized dirty columns, frames and private restoration, but adds **252 ADDs + 24 sign scales** with **zero recursive histogram delta**.
- A separate first-block dirty-scratch scalar control costs 100 ADDs in its explicit abstract contract. Its eight-centre model actively updates two centre rows; it does not implement a physical rank-one recursive COPY. Actual source acquisition, centre lifetimes and the changed full consumer remain unresolved.

The package retains exact matrices, witnesses, complete cost/obligation distinctions, source pins, unmodified predecessor sources and selected archive members, scoped stopping rules and open next questions. Hypothetical rank-32/two-unpaid ceilings remain planning screens; no second unpaid coordinate or replacement complex/bit coverage law is established. The selected frontier is unchanged.

## Validation and review

```sh
python3.12 -I -O -Werror -B research/selective-p112-codelivery/verify.py
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/selective-p112-codelivery
```

Both passed, as did a Git-free export, retained-source corruption rejection, and the registered replay in an isolated Git fixture without foreign PR commits. Generic provenance uses canonical-base objects; the direct verifier authenticates the vendored inputs against their retained original commit/blob/SHA256 inventory. No heavy native/global replay, unchanged-kernel recertification, rounded precision/hosting admission, Lean, Docker or full multiplication theorem is claimed.

A fresh clean-context GPT-6 Astra medium reviewer explicitly confirmed **CONCLUDE: YES** on scientific handoff `3e9546b23472b69851937b973da773faec25b0b5`, after checking the identities, source pins and archive members, actual source-frame ranks, dirty lifetimes and stopping scope. This is separate same-session AI review, not independent human or formal proof-kernel approval. Publication changes preserve the mathematical result and all retained source bytes. The same reviewer separately confirmed **CONCLUDE: YES** on publication artifact `b37d0e75433837482c351863a672543056f95bd5`, checked the complete packaging diff and source inventory, and reran the optimized Python 3.12 verifier; the isolated-checkout and overlap receipts remain author-reported.
